The Vision Behind VYS

Mir Shahlain Jalib

Visionary Youth Society was built on a simple belief: given a platform, a purpose and the right guidance, young people can lead real change.

Under the leadership of Mir Shahlain Jalib, the society brings together debate, culture and community action, and now opens its doors to one unforgettable event.

Chairman & Founder • VYS

Who We Are

A society for young minds with a purpose

Visionary Youth Society is a community of young thinkers who believe that ideas, spoken with courage and backed by action, can change the world around them.

Through debate, learning and leadership, we shape confident voices and turn conviction into meaningful community impact.

Our Pillars

Four principles. One purpose.

I

Debate

Sharpen reasoning, speak with conviction and learn to respect every side of an argument.

II

Learn

Grow through workshops, mentorship and a curiosity that never stops at the classroom door.

III

Lead

Take responsibility, build teams and step forward when it matters most.

IV

Create Impact

Turn ideas into initiatives that make a real difference in our communities.

What We Do

Programs that build leaders

Debates & Public Speaking

Structured debates and speaking sessions that build clarity, poise and confidence.

→

Workshops & Mentorship

Skill-building sessions guided by experienced mentors and guest speakers.

→

Leadership Council

Hands-on roles in management, outreach, media and partnerships.

→

Community Impact Projects

Youth-led campaigns and service projects that put our values into action.
